items.title: What Could Push ADSK Stock Higher From Here?
items.summary: Five years ago, Autodesk spent about $1.8 billion on a string of construction acquisitions. That bet has now compounded into a business generating almost $600 million in annual revenue. This segment is still growing north of 20%, a rate faster than the company average.

items.title: ADSK Stock: Where Compounding Could Take The Price
items.summary: At $205, Autodesk (ADSK) looks set up for roughly 49% of upside over the next three years under a conservative scenario. Not a moonshot, but enough to matter if the math holds. Revenue compounding does all the work; the multiple is asked to do nothing. Here is the operational reality the math is built on.

items.title: PTC (PTC) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Split On AI Growth
items.summary: PTC’s fair value estimate has been trimmed from US$190.53 to US$179.25, a cut of about US$11 per share that puts a fresh spotlight on how analysts are recalibrating expectations for the stock. The shift lines up with a mixed Street view, where some firms are lifting targets on product momentum and AI potential, while others keep Hold or Neutral ratings and lower targets around execution and valuation questions.
